proof:
Source: parent steps 3, 5 and 6 (first variation of the stationary varifold for the rotation field X = ψ(f)λ(|x|)ζ(x)Ax; Simon Ch. 4, 2.2–2.6). Conventions: H² := μHE[2]; μ = θ·H²⌞M ≪ H²⌞M; q(x) := x − πx; Ω := {⟨x,a⟩ > 0}; x̂ := x/|x|; w(x) := |p_{T_x}(Ax)|; ψ' := deriv ψ.
1. (Linear algebra.) (a, e) is an orthonormal basis of Q, so πx = ⟨x,a⟩a + ⟨x,e⟩e and |πx|² = ⟨x,a⟩² + ⟨x,e⟩². A is linear, ⟨Ax, y⟩ = −⟨x, Ay⟩, ⟨Ax, x⟩ = 0 and |Ax| = |πx|; hence w(x) ≤ |πx|, πx ≠ 0 on Ω, and 0 ≤ G ≤ 1 on Ω. For every subspace T with orthogonal projection P_T, tr(P_T∘A) = 0: tr(P_T A) = tr(P_T P_T A) = tr(P_T A P_T) by cyclicity, and B := P_T A P_T is antisymmetric (P_T self-adjoint), so tr B = Σ_i ⟨Bε_i, ε_i⟩ = 0 for an orthonormal basis (ε_i).
2. (Divergence of a rotation field.) Let g : ℝ^P → ℝ be differentiable at x and X(y) := g(y)·Ay. Then DX(x) = g(x)A + (Ax)⊗Dg(x), where ((v⊗L)u := L(u)v), so tangentialDivergence 2 M X x = tr(p_{T_x}∘DX(x)) = g(x)·tr(p_{T_x}A) + tr(u ↦ Dg(x)(u)·p_{T_x}(Ax)) = Dg(x)(p_{T_x}(Ax)) (step 1, and the trace of the rank-one map u ↦ L(u)v is L(v)).
3. (Angle function.) On the open set Ω (0 ∉ Ω), f is C^∞, |f| < π/2, f(rx) = f(x) for r > 0, and Df(x)(v) = ⟨Ax, v⟩/|πx|² (derivative of arctan(⟨x,e⟩/⟨x,a⟩)); |·| is C^∞ on ℝ^P ∖ {0} with D|·|(x)v = ⟨x̂, v⟩.
4. (Cut-off.) Let χ(τ) := Real.smoothTransition((4/3)(1 − τ)); χ ∈ C^∞(ℝ), χ = 1 on (−∞, 1/4] and χ = 0 on [1, ∞). For x ≠ 0 put u(x) := |q(x)|²/(s²|x|²) (C^∞ on ℝ^P ∖ {0}) and ζ(x) := χ(u(x)). Then ζ is C^∞ on ℝ^P ∖ {0}, ζ = 1 where |q(x)| ≤ (s/2)|x|, ζ = 0 where |q(x)| ≥ s|x|, and Dζ(x) = 0 whenever x ≠ 0 and |q(x)| < (s/2)|x| or |q(x)| > s|x| (then u < 1/4, resp. u > 1, on a neighbourhood of x, where ζ is constant).
5. (The vector field.) Since tsupport ψ is a compact subset of (−s, s) and tsupport l a compact subset of (1 − s, 1 + s), there are s_ψ, s_l < s with tsupport ψ ⊆ [−s_ψ, s_ψ] and tsupport l ⊆ [1 − s_l, 1 + s_l]. Define g(x) := ψ(f(x))·l(|x|)·ζ(x) if ⟨x,a⟩ > 0 and g(x) := 0 otherwise, and X(x) := g(x)·Ax. Let K := {x : ⟨x,a⟩ ≥ 0, |⟨x,e⟩| ≤ tan(s_ψ)⟨x,a⟩, ||x| − 1| ≤ s_l, |q(x)| ≤ s|x|}, a closed bounded (hence compact) set. If g(x) ≠ 0 then x ∈ Ω, |f(x)| ≤ s_ψ (so |⟨x,e⟩| ≤ tan(s_ψ)⟨x,a⟩), ||x| − 1| ≤ s_l and ζ(x) ≠ 0 (so |q(x)| < s|x|): thus {g ≠ 0} ⊆ K. Moreover K ⊆ Ω: for x ∈ K, |x| ≥ 1 − s ≥ 3/4, |πx|² = |x|² − |q(x)|² ≥ (1 − s²)|x|² > 0, and |πx|² = ⟨x,a⟩² + ⟨x,e⟩² ≤ (1 + tan² s_ψ)⟨x,a⟩², so ⟨x,a⟩ ≥ cos(s_ψ)|πx| > 0. On the open set Ω, g = (ψ∘f)·(l∘|·|)·ζ is C¹ (ψ, l ∈ C¹; f, |·|, ζ are C^∞ on Ω ⊆ ℝ^P ∖ {0}); on the open set ℝ^P ∖ K, g ≡ 0. These open sets cover ℝ^P, so g is C¹ on ℝ^P with tsupport g ⊆ K compact, and X = g·A is C¹ with compact support.
6. (First variation as a μ-integral.) By (i), R.firstVariation X = 0. x ↦ p_{T_x} is a.e.-strongly measurable for H²⌞M (`Submission.imrep_approxTangent_starProjection_aesm`), hence a.e.-measurable for μ ≪ H²⌞M; so `Submission.dsmc_firstVariation_eq_integral` (U := univ) gives that x ↦ tangentialDivergence 2 M X x is μ-integrable with R.firstVariation X = ∫ tangentialDivergence 2 M X x dμ(x). By step 2, ∫ Dg(x)(p_{T_x}(Ax)) dμ(x) = 0.
7. (Pointwise identity μ-a.e.) Let x lie outside the μ-null sets where (ii) or (iii) fails. If x ∉ Ω then x ∉ K, g ≡ 0 near x and Dg(x) = 0. If x ∈ Ω, then with v := p_{T_x}(Ax): Dg(x)(v) = ψ'(f(x))l(|x|)ζ(x)·Df(x)(v) + ψ(f(x))ζ(x)l'(|x|)·⟨x̂, v⟩ + ψ(f(x))l(|x|)·Dζ(x)(v). (a) ⟨x̂, v⟩ = ⟨p_{T_x}x̂, Ax⟩ = ⟨x̂, Ax⟩ = 0 (p_{T_x} self-adjoint, p_{T_x}x = x by (ii), step 1). (b) If ψ(f(x))l(|x|) ≠ 0 then |f(x)| < s and ||x| − 1| < s, so by (iii) |q(x)| < (s/2)|x| or |q(x)| > 2s|x| > s|x|, and Dζ(x) = 0 by step 4; so the third term always vanishes. (c) Df(x)(v) = ⟨Ax, p_{T_x}(Ax)⟩/|πx|² = |p_{T_x}(Ax)|²/|πx|² = G(x) (p_{T_x} idempotent and self-adjoint). If ψ'(f(x))l(|x|)ζ(x) ≠ 0 then |f(x)| < s (ψ' vanishes on the open set ℝ ∖ tsupport ψ), ||x| − 1| < s and |q(x)| < s|x| (ζ(x) ≠ 0), i.e. x ∈ Z_s, and then (iii) forces |q(x)| < (s/2)|x|, i.e. ζ(x) = 1. Hence, for μ-a.e. x, Dg(x)(p_{T_x}(Ax)) = 1_{Z_s}(x)·ψ'(f(x))·l(|x|)·G(x).
8. (Conclusion.) The function φ(x) := ψ'(f(x))·l(|x|)·G(x) is a.e.-strongly measurable for μ (ψ' and l are continuous, f and |·| measurable, G a.e.-measurable through p_{T_x} as in step 6), bounded by sup|ψ'|·sup|l| on Z_s ⊆ Ω (0 ≤ G ≤ 1 there), and μ(Z_s) ≤ μ(closedBall(0, 2)) < ∞ (Z_s ⊆ B_2(0); μ is finite on compact sets by locallyIntegrable_mult). So φ is μ-integrable on Z_s, and by steps 6–7, ∫_{Z_s} φ dμ = ∫ Dg(x)(p_{T_x}(Ax)) dμ(x) = 0. ∎
key_steps: A is antisymmetric with |Ax| = |πx|, so tr(P_T A) = 0 and div_{T_x}(gA) = Dg(x)(p_{T_x}Ax) for any subspace T_x.
X := ψ(f)·l(|x|)·ζ(x)·Ax (ζ a cut-off in |q|/|x|) is C¹ with compact support inside Ω.
Stationarity and dsmc_firstVariation_eq_integral give ∫ Dg(x)(p_{T_x}Ax) dμ = 0.
μ-a.e.: the radial term vanishes by radial tangency; Dζ = 0 by the gap hypothesis; Df(x)(p_{T_x}Ax) = G(x) and ζ = 1 on the support of ψ'(f)l.
Hence ∫_{Z_s} ψ'(f)l(|x|)G dμ = 0, with integrability from 0 ≤ G ≤ 1 and μ(Z_s) < ∞.
